title: My Strong, Safe Rock
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler of the brave start, and tonight the psalm-writer calls Heavenly Father the Rock that does not wobble: on his first day at a new preschool Beau’s legs feel wobbly, he takes a deep breath, remembers his strong Rock, and walks in.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he leans on Heavenly Father when he feels weak. In Beau’s world today: it was Beau’s first day at a new preschool, and his legs felt wobbly and unsure. He took a deep breath and remembered Heavenly Father was his strong Rock, holding him up. He felt steadier, walked in, and even made a new friend. Just like the psalm-writer trusted Heavenly Father as his Rock, Beau leaned on Him and found his strong.
